articles.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

articles.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
articles.snippet: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

articles.title: Judge Orders Bitcoin Wallet Returned to Family of Convicted Canadian Killer
articles.snippet: A Nova Scotia judge found prosecutors failed to link William Sandeson's Bitcoin to the 2015 murder of fellow student Taylor Samson.

articles.title: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
articles.snippet: GitBook says attackers accessed infrastructure credentials in an AI-assisted breach, prompting a shutdown and emergency token resets.
